messages:
rachel_csm: Quick preflight for Acadia go-live tomorrow 07:00 PT. Short checklist attached — focus on prefill, warm caches, and streaming handshake. TL;DR: tiny staged ramp, smoke checks, renewal watch.

ben_sre: Ops note: start with batching OFF for first 3m, then enable batch_size=4 window_ms=200. If p50 > 350ms after any step -> set batch_size=1 and disable streaming. Add p95 alert to paging if > 900ms for 10m.

kari_te: Small onboarding script snippet for smoke tests:
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"acadia-v2","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
Expect true. Also do a cache write/read check against KV prefix: kv/acadia/$TENANT.

sam_pm: Renewal watch rule: if week-1 DAU < 18% forecast AND sustained error_rate > 1.2% over 6h -> create renewal_watch ticket and CSM outreach within 24h. CSM checklist before outreach: confirm keys, confirm model pin, verify whether streaming or non-streaming path is used.

deploy-bot: deploy: onboarding-prefill-small rolled to staging @ 2026-04-02T02:14:00Z - smoke x3 passed.

rachel_csm: Thanks! Action items: I will send kickoff note, kari add curl + KV check to onboarding script, ben add p95 paging rule, sam add renewal_watch. I'll monitor telemetry first 12h and post flags here. :rocket:
